t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The previous particiapant found that certain colour knomes had higher points blue, yellow, orange and pink, also the highest on 5x is 45

vb_textbox.text: I found that the purple knome consistently paid the most points. I focused on the x5 knomes that had the most points to try and get maximum points. The x1 paid so little (Max i think was 9 points ) that it seemed worthwhile to disregard those and focus on the higher paid ones.n Even when focusing on the purple knome the points did vary so i tried to mix it up and add in brown or pink if the purple one wasnt an option. Good luck!
